title: Simultaneous energy and entropy stability of volume-penalisation immersed-boundary methods for the compressible Navier--Stokes equations
summary: Immersed-boundary methods avoid body-fitted meshes, but the energy or entropy stability of the underlying flow discretisation does not automatically extend to the immersed treatment. This manuscript analyses the volume-penalised compressible Navier--Stokes equations for both energy and entropy stability, on the continuous and semi-discrete levels, and integrates the isolated source exactly in time.
